notes: Your own games + ROM hacks: Settings → 'My games & ROM hacks' → Add. Import a ROM (.gb/.gbc/.gba/.nds) directly, or apply an IPS/UPS/BPS patch to a clean base ROM you supply — the patcher verifies the checksum and refuses a wrong base ROM instead of making a broken game. The result plays in the built-in emulator. (You supply your own ROMs/patches — no downloads. Dex/badge tracking for custom games comes later.)
